prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1331; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give my first name for now, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were driving when the collision happened?

A: I was heading east on a main road in Pasadena, in the right lane. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me, so I was already stopping.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: What happened next?

A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind and my head snapped forward and then back against the headrest.

Q: Did you hit your head on anything?

A: I don't think so, but my head hurt right away and I felt dizzy. I sat in the car for a few minutes before I got out.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They told me I have a concussion. I've had headaches, trouble concentrating, and I get sensitive to light.

Q: Are you still under a doctor's care?

A: Yes, I have a follow-up appointment next week, and I've been told to limit screen time and rest as much as I can.

Q: Did anyone else get hurt?

A: No, my passenger was fine. The other driver was shaken up but I didn't see any injuries on their side.

Q: Did you take any photos of the vehicles or the scene?

A: Yes, I took a few on my phone before the tow truck arrived. I can send them to you.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Just that I'm having a hard time working right now because of the symptoms. I'd appreciate it if this could move along as quickly as possible.

Q: Understood. This concludes the recorded statement. Thank you.
